name: @amykit/plugin-slack
description: A Slack thread per piece of work, over the Web API, as the conversation port.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when you want to follow and answer amy from Slack. It mounts the conversation port: each piece of work gets a thread in one channel, and only the operator's replies count as answers. It can also hold amy's chat. It needs a bot token, read from the environment or a file.
